config.expected_if_true: In both seeds, the final best-layer force and accel_step margins and the step-3000 val_mse_ratio are within 0.01 (margins) and 5% (val_mse_ratio) of run-20261013-042340-5024 (seed 20) and run-20261013-042340-4a86 (seed 21).
config.hypothesis: Under the current pipeline, training and probing are deterministic for a fixed seed. A second identical rerun of the N=256, 3000-step config (seeds 20-21, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], m2 in [0.1, 1], data_seed 0, best-of-3 controls), matched to exp-20261013-031820-91ca, reproduces that rerun's final best-layer margins: force 0.113 / 0.003 and accel_step 0.162 / 0.198 for seeds 20 / 21. If it does, cross-length and cross-N differences of about 0.02 or more can be read directly.
